name: taxonomy
description: The categories a post is filed under — Loothprint Type and Content Topic — as chips linking to their term archives. Reads the post's terms LIVE at render, so the page cannot drift from the form. Declares no term picker on purpose: the form owns the details, and a second editor for one value is how the two end up disagreeing.

taxonomies.description: Taxonomy slugs to show, in order. Unregistered ones and ones the post has no terms in are skipped silently rather than rendered as an empty row.

title.description: Optional uppercase eyebrow above the chips. Empty = no title row.

link.description: Link each chip to its term archive. When false the chips are plain text — never a link-styled element that does nothing.

variant.description: chips renders pills; inline renders a middot-separated run for dense pages.
